job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy large language models using Azure AI Search to improve search functionality on e-commerce platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate natural language processing (NLP) capabilities into existing systems.
Develop and maintain complex NLP pipelines using tools like LangChain for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
Troubleshoot issues related to model performance, scalability, and reliability in a production environment.

Job Requirements :

8-12 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering with expertise in Large Language Model development.
Strong understanding of Azure AI Search services including its architecture, features, and integrations.
Proficiency in developing custom solutions using Azure Functions or other serverless technologies.
Experience working with open-source libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch for building machine learning models.
